send_telemetry_ping: send telemetry with a ping topic to track basic library usage
send_telemetry_gradio: send telemetry for gradio/local_link with library name and version
send_telemetry_transformers: send telemetry for transformers examples with pipeline and framework user agent data
send_telemetry_disable: disable telemetry collection by setting HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY environment variable
send_telemetry_offline: disable telemetry automatically when HF_HUB_OFFLINE environment variable is set
